notes.title: Devlog #2 – Profits, Deals, and Organized Chaos! 💰
notes.content:
Greetings, traders and schemers! Today, we're diving deeper into the heart of our pawnshop to reveal some key mechanics that will make your adventure even more flavorful. As you know – a good pawnshop isn’t just about selling, but also about the fine art of buying. And since you're in this business, there's one thing to always keep in mind: profit is king!

💸 Selling – The Art of Persuasion… Ahem, Trading!
Selling is the backbone of this business, but don’t think it’s just a formality! Every customer is a puzzle. Some will haggle like a stingy grandpa, while others will blow their last paycheck on a set of fancy glassware just because they "used to have the same one back in the day."

And you? You need to know when to push and when to squeeze every last coin out of a deal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/41ab41c7a2365a8a783a32a21d2446fd8819d00b.gif

💰 Buying – Prices? … That's up for debate!
Selling isn’t everything—sometimes, it’s just as important to buy. Why? Because what looks like junk today might turn into a golden goose tomorrow.

Every item you find can be flipped for a quick buck, but sometimes it pays to hold onto things and wait for the right moment. The pawnshop economy is a living beast—you never know when some weirdo will decide that a cheap plastic karate figurine from ten years ago is suddenly a “collector’s item.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/d35d4503f097cc523231c826c395d69e9f8bb870.gif

🗑 Items from Alternative Sources ;)
Imagine that the best deals sometimes wait in the most unexpected places. A true pawnbroker doesn’t limit themselves to traditional methods—they have to be creative, or the competition will eat them alive. 

So, what do you do when great finds don’t come knocking on your door in the hands of customers with real treasures to sell? You step outside and start looking for those treasures yourself (wink wink).business upside down while you're gone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/fa29e7d4b9577d5a2a58f49d3b8910f3b90532c8.gif

💼 Final Thoughts – Stay Smart, Stay Profitable!
In the world of pawnshops, it’s not just about what you sell—it’s about how and when you sell it. A good trader knows when to cut a deal, when to hold onto an item, and when to convince a customer that a rusty pocket knife is actually a priceless antique.
So, keep your wits sharp, your shop organized, and most importantly—never let a good deal slip through your fingers! 🏚️💰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/6ef638a75564f0628285589e5c7b3535864c1f34.gif

🔍 What’s Next?
Even the greediest pawnbroker isn’t alone in this world—there’s always someone around. In the near future, we might take a closer look at certain relationships. Stay tuned!

https://discord.gg/WWSpaE6k

notes.title: Join the Playtest of Pawnshop 90s!
notes.content:
Greetings Pawnshop Enthusiasts,

We're thrilled to invite you to participate in the playtesting phase of Pawnshop 90s! This is your chance to dive into the nostalgic world of 1990s Poland, where you'll step into the shoes of a pawnshop owner. Experience the thrill of managing your business, interacting with a diverse range of customers, and navigating the challenges and opportunities of the era.

Registration for Playtests is Now Open!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/e84a38b77d57b4a15407a3239808d03b1284fcd8.png

Join us in shaping the future of Pawnshop 90s. Your feedback will be invaluable as we fine-tune gameplay mechanics and polish our vision for the game. Don't miss out on this exclusive opportunity to be among the first to experience the game firsthand.

How to Participate:
Sign Up for Playtests: Click "SIGN UP THE PLAYTESTS" to visit our Steam page and register.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/1f35f0ed794d3e236256102216c383ec4a7769fd.png

Join Our Community: Connect with fellow players and developers on Discord. Share your thoughts, report bugs, and engage directly with the development team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148786/ec035564fd42d013cbee9f1515b2b465b3f6dcab.png

About Pawnshop 90s:

Explore a Unique Setting:  Immerse yourself in the economic realities of 1990s Poland, where every item tells a story and every transaction shapes your business.
Become a Savvy Entrepreneur: Buy, sell, and negotiate your way to success. Upgrade your shop, expand your inventory, and cater to a variety of customer needs.
Embrace the Challenges: From managing finances to handling unexpected situations, every decision counts in your journey to pawnshop prominence.

Press Pack and More:  For press inquiries and additional information, please visit our Press Pack.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. Together, let's build the ultimate pawnshop empire in the heart of 1990s Poland!

Sincerely,
Yeyuna and CreativeForge Games
